blocks.markdown: Reflexive verbs like **se laver** (to wash oneself) and **s'habiller** (to get dressed) need a reflexive pronoun that matches the subject: **je me lave**, **tu te laves**, **il/elle/on se lave**, **nous nous lavons**, **vous vous lavez**, **ils/elles se lavent**.
Before a vowel sound, **me/te/se** shorten to **m'/t'/s'**: *je m'habille* (I get dressed), not *je me habille*.

exercises.prompt: Je ___ lave. (se laver — I wash myself.)
Nous ___ levons tôt. (se lever — We get up early.)
